title: Rhythm, beat and tempo
examples: Teacher, what is the difference between beat and rhythm?
Can you show us a really fast tempo song?
How do we clap a steady beat?

explain.say: Listen to the music. Tap your foot to the steady beat.
The beat stays steady all through the song. You can march or tap to it.
Rhythm is a pattern of long and short sounds. The words of a song have a rhythm.
Tempo is how fast or slow the music goes. A lullaby has a slow tempo.
Clap this rhythm with me. Clap, clap, rest, clap.
When you march to music, your feet follow the beat. Your claps can make a rhythm on top.

faq.q: What is the difference between beat and rhythm?
faq.a: The beat is the steady, underlying pulse you feel. Rhythm is the pattern of sounds played over that beat.
asks: Is beat the same as tempo?
What is the pulse in music?

faq.q: How do I know if the music is fast or slow?
faq.a: You can tap your foot or clap along. If you tap fast, the tempo is fast.
asks: Can you name a slow song?

faq.a: Tempo is the speed of the music, telling us how fast or slow the beat is.

faq.q: Do I need to count to keep the beat?
faq.a: It is helpful to count to keep a steady beat. Counting helps your body feel the regular pulse.

faq.q: Can rhythm change even if the beat stays the same?
faq.a: Yes, the beat stays steady, but the rhythm can change with different sounds. Think of clapping patterns.

facts: The beat is the consistent, underlying pulse in music.
Rhythm is the pattern of sounds, including long and short notes.
Tempo describes the speed of the music, ranging from slow to fast.
Clapping patterns help us practise rhythm.

quiz.say: Think of a gentle lullaby for a baby. Tap its tempo.
quiz.why: A lullaby has a slow tempo. Slow music helps a baby rest.

wrong.0: Fast music makes you want to run and jump.
wrong.2: Loud is about how strong the sound is, and tempo is about speed.

quiz.say: Think of the steady pulse you tap your foot to. Tap its name.
quiz.why: The beat is the steady pulse. You tap your foot to it.

wrong.0: Tempo is how fast or slow the music goes.
wrong.1: Rhythm is a pattern of long and short sounds.

quiz.say: Clap, clap, rest, clap. Tap the name of this pattern.
quiz.why: A pattern of sounds and rests is a rhythm.

wrong.1: Tempo is the speed of the music.
wrong.2: The beat stays steady, and the claps make a pattern on top.
